description: List all clusters in a subscription.

operations.description: Lists all clusters in a subscription.

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: The link used to get the next page of cluster list.
props.name: nextLink

props.description: The list of clusters
Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. E.g. "/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}"
props.name: id

props.description: The geo-location where the resource lives
props.name: location

props.description: The name of the resource
props.name: name

props.description: Properties of the cluster.
props.name: properties

props.description: The administrator's login name of the servers in the cluster.
props.name: administratorLogin

props.description: The Citus extension version on all cluster servers.
props.name: citusVersion

props.description: If public access is enabled on coordinator.
props.name: coordinatorEnablePublicIpAccess

props.description: The edition of a coordinator server (default: GeneralPurpose). Required for creation.
props.name: coordinatorServerEdition

props.description: The storage of a server in MB. Required for creation. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/cosmos-db/postgresql/resources-compute for more information.
props.name: coordinatorStorageQuotaInMb

props.description: The vCores count of a server (max: 96). Required for creation. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/cosmos-db/postgresql/resources-compute for more information.
props.name: coordinatorVCores

props.description: The earliest restore point time (ISO8601 format) for the cluster.
props.name: earliestRestoreTime

props.description: If high availability (HA) is enabled or not for the cluster.
props.name: enableHa

props.description: If distributed tables are placed on coordinator or not. Should be set to 'true' on single node clusters. Requires shard rebalancing after value is changed.
props.name: enableShardsOnCoordinator

props.description: Maintenance window of a cluster.
props.name: maintenanceWindow

props.description: Indicates whether custom maintenance window is enabled or not.
props.name: customWindow

props.description: Preferred day of the week for maintenance window.
props.name: dayOfWeek

props.description: Start hour within preferred day of the week for maintenance window.
props.name: startHour

props.description: Start minute within the start hour for maintenance window.
props.name: startMinute

props.description: Worker node count of the cluster. When node count is 0, it represents a single node configuration with the ability to create distributed tables on that node. 2 or more worker nodes represent multi-node configuration. Node count value cannot be 1. Required for creation.
props.name: nodeCount

props.description: If public access is enabled on worker nodes.
props.name: nodeEnablePublicIpAccess

props.description: The edition of a node server (default: MemoryOptimized).
props.name: nodeServerEdition

props.description: The storage in MB on each worker node. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/cosmos-db/postgresql/resources-compute for more information.
props.name: nodeStorageQuotaInMb

props.description: The compute in vCores on each worker node (max: 104). See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/cosmos-db/postgresql/resources-compute for more information.
props.name: nodeVCores

props.description: Date and time in UTC (ISO8601 format) for cluster restore.
props.name: pointInTimeUTC

props.description: The major PostgreSQL version on all cluster servers.
props.name: postgresqlVersion

props.description: Preferred primary availability zone (AZ) for all cluster servers.
props.name: preferredPrimaryZone
